CheckTitle: EC2 Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) is disabled
Description: EC2 Instance found that have Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) is disabled.
Risk: IMDSv2 uses session-oriented requests, and protects from misconfiguration and SSRF vulnerabilities.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure IMDSv2 is enabled for EC2 Instances.
